import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { recoveryEffectsMarkdown } from '@src/utils/resourceRecoveryDisplay';
/**
 * 本命物详情指令
 * 指令：/本命物详情 <实例ID>
 */
import App from '@src/response-apps/soulArtifact/detail/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { soulArtifactActions } from '@src/response/soulArtifact/capabilities';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

const COMMAND_REGEX = /^(!|！|\/|#|＃)?本命物详情\s+(\d+)$/;

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const match = (e.MessageText ?? '').trim().match(COMMAND_REGEX);

  if (!match?.[2]) {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('请输入本命物实例编号');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('用法：/本命物详情 123');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '本命物详情', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  const instanceId = Number(match[2]);
  const result = await App({ bid, uid, instanceId });

  if (result.code !== 'OK') {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText(result.data.message);

    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: '本命物详情',
        header: [{ label: '返回储物袋', command: '/储物袋 本命' }],
        content: md
      })
    );

    return;
  }

  const artifact = result.data;
  const maxLevel = result.data.maxLevel;

  const contentMd = Format.createMarkdown();

  contentMd.addText(`本命物：${artifact.name}（${artifact.gradeName}）`);
  contentMd.addNewline();
  contentMd.addText(`编号：${artifact.instanceId}`);
  contentMd.addNewline();
  contentMd.addText(`状态：${artifact.statusText}`);
  contentMd.addNewline();
  contentMd.addText(`定位：${artifact.category} · ${artifact.positioning}`);
  contentMd.addNewline();
  contentMd.addText(`等级：Lv.${artifact.level} / ${maxLevel}`);
  contentMd.addNewline();
  contentMd.addText(`洗涤：${artifact.washCount}次（${artifact.washQuality}）`);
  contentMd.addNewline();
  if (artifact.revealedAffixCount < artifact.maxAffixCount) {
    contentMd.addText(`显现词条：${artifact.revealedAffixCount} / ${artifact.maxAffixCount}`);
    contentMd.addNewline();
  }
  contentMd.addNewline();

  if (artifact.recoveryEffects?.length) {
    contentMd.addBlockquote(recoveryEffectsMarkdown(artifact.recoveryEffects));
    contentMd.addNewline();
  }
  contentMd.addText('基础面板');
  contentMd.addNewline();

  for (const panel of artifact.basePanels) {
    contentMd.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(` ${panel.name}：${panel.value}`));
  }

  contentMd.addNewline();
  contentMd.addText('词条');
  contentMd.addNewline();

  for (const panel of artifact.panels) {
    const tag = panel.affixTypeName;

    if (panel.isPercent) {
      contentMd.addBlockquote(
        Format.createMarkdown().addText(` ${panel.name}(${tag})：${+Number(panel.washBonus).toFixed(2)}% / ${+Number(panel.washCap).toFixed(2)}%`)
      );
    } else {
      contentMd.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(` ${panel.name}(${tag})：${panel.washBonus} / ${panel.washCap}`));
    }

    contentMd.addNewline();
  }

  contentMd.addNewline();
  contentMd.addText('说明');
  contentMd.addNewline();
  if (artifact.revealedAffixCount < artifact.maxAffixCount) {
    contentMd.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(' 本命物初得仅显现少量词条'));
  }
  contentMd.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(' 洗涤会触发新增 / 替换 / 升级').addNewline().addText(' 品级每提升一阶，词条上限 +1'));
  const actionMd = Format.createMarkdown();

  for (const action of soulArtifactActions(artifact.capabilities)) {
    actionMd.addText(' ').addButton(action.label, { data: action.command });
  }
  actionMd.addText(' ').addButton('储物袋 · 本命', { data: '/储物袋 本命' });
  contentMd.addBlockquote(actionMd);

  void message.send(
    FormatGui({
      isPrivate,
      bid,
      title: '本命物详情',
      header: [
        { label: '返回储物袋', command: '/储物袋 本命' },
        { label: '本命物信息', command: '/本命物信息' }
      ],
      content: contentMd
    })
  );
});
